description: This file defines a Sidebar component and related subcomponents for a React UI, including context management, toggle functionality, and various UI elements like buttons, headers, and menus, with styling and responsiveness considerations.

methods.name: useSidebar
methods.description: Custom hook to access sidebar context, throws error if used outside provider.

methods.name: SidebarProvider
methods.description: Provides sidebar state and controls, manages cookies and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.description: Main sidebar component with responsive behavior and collapsible options.

methods.description: Button to toggle sidebar open/close state.

methods.name: SidebarRail
methods.description: Button for sidebar toggle with visual indicator.

methods.name: SidebarInset
methods.description: Main content area inset for sidebar layout.

methods.name: SidebarInput
methods.description: Input component styled for sidebar use.

methods.description: CVA variants for sidebar menu buttons.
